market_summary: Broad market shows dominant USD strength and crypto weakness with XAUUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD, and BTCUSD all trading below their daily VWAP, EMA50, and Value Areas. However, all four are currently experiencing counter-trend retracements or consolidations above session lows near their lower ATR bands without fresh RVOL breakout volume. US100 remains bullish above VWAP/EMA50 but has rallied directly into major Call Resistance Walls (28433-28443) under a Positive Dampening GEX regime, capping further upside momentum. Complete discipline dictates a HOLD across all instruments until clear breakout or mean-reversion triggers emerge.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (3911.54) and below POC (3978.13). CVD is BEARISH (-8.10) agreeing with the macro downward trend, though short-term slope shows slight retracement (+1.38). In NEW_YORK_SESSION, price is trading substantially below downward-sloping VWAP (3939.16) and EMA50 (3924.92). The signal candle tapped into the lower ATR band (3869.74) near Session Low (3852.35) and is now retracing mid-channel intrabar toward EMA20 (3893.17). RVOL is normal (0.996) with no fresh breakout volume. With no GEX and price caught mid-rebound inside extended territory, waiting for a cleaner retest of EMA20/VWAP or breakdown.
signals.level_event: rejection at lower ATR and bounce from Session Low

signals.rationale: Trading below VAL (1.1075) and POC (1.10943). CVD is NEUTRAL (-3,061) with positive slope (+3,964), showing fading bearish momentum. In NEW_YORK_SESSION, price remains trapped under downward-sloping VWAP (1.10814) and EMA50 (1.10815). The candle structure is pressing near the lower ATR band (1.10562) hovering just above Session Low support at 1.10533. RVOL is 1.216 without fresh yellow spikes. Lacking strong breakout volume below Session Low or bullish structural reclaim above S/R 1.10662, setup warrants HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below declining VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price resides below VAL (1.32533) and POC (1.32731). CVD is BEARISH (-8,768) confirming broader trend, though short-term cvd_slope (+5,568) exhibits short-covering pressure. In NEW_YORK_SESSION, trend is strictly bearish below both VWAP (1.32584) and EMA50 (1.32590). Signal candle and forming bar hover above the lower ATR band (1.32287) and Session Low (1.32210). RVOL is 1.345, insufficient to confirm an immediate continuation breakdown. Holding mid-consolidation above support.

Price is above VAH (28231.55) and POC (28122.95). CVD is NEUTRAL (+0.72) with modest positive slope (+0.25). In NEW_YORK_SESSION, price trades comfortably above rising VWAP (28153.97) and EMA50 (28182.92). However, GEX context indicates POSITIVE_DAMPENING regime above Gamma Flip (28250.74). Price is currently pressing directly into Call Wall #1 (28433.61) and Call Wall #2 (28443.61) right at the upper ATR band (28457.52). Buying directly into the Call Wall under a dampening regime is strictly prohibited by GEX rules, while shorting against the strong intraday trend lacks RVOL confirmation.
signals.level_event: rejection at Call Wall #1 / upper ATR band

signals.rationale: Price is well below VAL (72396.0) and POC (73501.6). CVD is BEARISH (-0.08) aligning with the steep selloff. In NEW_YORK_SESSION, price is trading underneath descending VWAP (72899.82) and EMA50 (72682.40). The signal candle tagged the lower ATR band (71304.43) holding above Session Low (71141.0), and the forming bar is executing a sharp bounce toward EMA20 (72048.07). RVOL is normal at 1.096 without yellow spike confirmation. As the market is caught in a counter-trend bounce mid-channel, chasing a short is poor risk/reward and buying counter-trend lacks confluence.
